YuriiHoliuk/budget-sync.message:
Merge pull request #2 from YuriiHoliuk/phase-2-drop-old-budget-columns

Phase 2: Drop old budget columns

Phase 2: Drop old budget columns (type, targetCadence, targetCadenceMonths)

- Add migration 0008 to drop deprecated columns
- Remove dual-write code from DatabaseBudgetMapper
- Simplify schema to use only new cadence columns
- Update tests to remove old column references

This is a destructive migration that completes the schema cleanup
started in Phase 1. Phase 1 added new columns and backfilled data,
while Phase 2 removes the old columns that are no longer needed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge pull request #1 from YuriiHoliuk/phase-1-additive-migrations

Add missing fractional-indexing package

Required for budget ordering feature.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Phase 1: Add new schema columns with backward compatibility

Additive-only migrations for budget system improvements:

Schema Changes:
- Add cadence_unit and cadence_count columns (keep target_cadence, target_cadence_months)
- Create budget_targets table for target history tracking
- Add sort_order column for custom budget ordering
- Create budget_groups table for budget grouping
- Keep type column for backward compatibility

Code Changes:
- Domain entity uses new cadenceUnit/cadenceCount fields
- DatabaseBudgetMapper implements dual-read (new columns with fallback to old)
- DatabaseBudgetMapper implements dual-write (writes to both old and new columns)
- All tests updated for new schema structure

This is Phase 1 of a two-phase migration. Phase 2 will drop old columns after
verifying production data is correctly migrated.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Fix CI change detection: compare against deployed commit SHA

Instead of diffing HEAD~1 (fragile with amended/squashed commits),
fetch the actual deployed commit SHA from Cloud Run image tags and
diff against that. Falls back to deploying when SHA can't be resolved.

Make all budgets accumulate and remove equalization

All budget types now use a single accumulating formula:
available = SUM(allocations up to month) - SUM(spending up to month).
Spending budgets no longer reset positive balance monthly.

Added suggested allocation logic per budget type (spending, savings,
goal, periodic) with cap support. Removed EqualizeAllocations use case,
GraphQL mutation, frontend equalize buttons, and related tests.

Updated schema with new `cap` column, GraphQL types with
`suggestedAllocation` field, budget dialogs, and E2E tests.

Refactor Ready to Assign to flow-based calculation

Changes the budget calculation from balance-based to flow-based approach,
following YNAB envelope budgeting model.

Formula change:
- OLD: readyToAssign = availableFunds - totalAllocated
- NEW: readyToAssign = totalInflows - totalAllocated

Where totalInflows = sum(account initial balances) + sum(income)
